name: dunning_weekend_shift_calendar
source_sql: SELECT TO_CHAR(DATE '2026-09-01' + (LEVEL - 1), 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS "as_of", TO_CHAR(DATE '2026-09-01' + (LEVEL - 1) + DECODE(TO_CHAR(DATE '2026-09-01' + (LEVEL - 1), 'DY', 'NLS_DATE_LANGUAGE=ENGLISH'), 'SAT', 2, 'SUN', 1, 0), 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS "scheduled_for" FROM dual CONNECT BY LEVEL <= 21 ORDER BY 1
target_sql: SELECT to_char(g.d, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS as_of, to_char(g.d + (CASE EXTRACT(ISODOW FROM g.d) WHEN 6 THEN 2 WHEN 7 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * INTERVAL '1 day', 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS scheduled_for FROM generate_series(DATE '2026-09-01', DATE '2026-09-21', INTERVAL '1 day') AS g(d) ORDER BY 1

name: dunning_attempt_id_formula
source_sql: SELECT id AS "id", pkg_ow_util.f_md5_uuid(invoice_id || TO_CHAR(attempt_no)) AS "derived_id" FROM ow_billing.dunning_attempts ORDER BY 1
target_sql: SELECT id, billing.f_md5_uuid(invoice_id || attempt_no::text) AS derived_id FROM billing.dunning_attempts ORDER BY 1

name: dunning_log_line_text
source_sql: SELECT TO_CHAR(DATE '2026-09-01' + (LEVEL - 1), 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS "as_of", 'scheduled ' || TO_CHAR(LEVEL - 1) || ' attempts as of ' || TO_CHAR(DATE '2026-09-01' + (LEVEL - 1), 'DD-MON-YY', 'NLS_DATE_LANGUAGE=ENGLISH') AS "message" FROM dual CONNECT BY LEVEL <= 21 ORDER BY 1
target_sql: SELECT to_char(g.d, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS as_of, 'scheduled ' || (g.d::date - DATE '2026-09-01')::text || ' attempts as of ' || billing.f_dt2str(g.d::date) AS message FROM generate_series(DATE '2026-09-01', DATE '2026-09-21', INTERVAL '1 day') AS g(d) ORDER BY 1

name: suspension_notification_id_formula
source_sql: SELECT id AS "id", pkg_ow_util.f_md5_uuid(tenant_id || 'suspension' || TO_CHAR(TRUNC(CAST(sent_at AS DATE)), 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS "derived_id" FROM ow_billing.notifications WHERE kind_cd = 3 ORDER BY 1
target_sql: SELECT id, billing.f_md5_uuid(tenant_id || 'suspension' || to_char(date_trunc('day', sent_at), 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS derived_id FROM billing.notifications WHERE kind_cd = 3 ORDER BY 1
